privacy.clearAll: Share duk ChainBeat data a cikin wannan browser
privacy.description: Abin da wannan app ke adanawa da kuma abin da zai iya gani.
privacy.keysCaption: Shafin bincike da ChainBeat ke amfani da shi
privacy.noNetwork: ChainBeat ba ya aika da bayanai a ko'ina: ba shi da nazari kuma baya yin buƙatu sai don fayilolin kansa. Akwai keɓancewa biyu na zaɓi: maɓallin Test connection, wanda kawai ya bayyana lokacin da kuka saita ƙarshen maɓallin kuma ya aika buƙatun karantawa guda biyu zuwa gare shi, da maɓallin shiga Google, wanda kawai ya bayyana bayan kun ƙara ID na abokin ciniki na Google kuma an ɗora shi daga Google.
privacy.noSeed: ChainBeat ba ya tambayar, adana ko ganin kalmar farko, maɓallin sirri ko kalmar sirri na walat.
privacy.storage: Zaɓuɓɓuka, hanyar sadarwar da aka zaɓa, agogon kwaikwayo, walat ɗin Demo, binciken da aka yi kwanan nan da duk wani asusun demo da kuka ƙirƙira an adana su ne kawai a cikin localStorage na wannan mai bincike.
privacy.title: Sirri
privacy.wallet: Idan ka haɗa wani browser wallet tsawo, ChainBeat karanta kawai your jama'a address da asusun sunan, kuma kawai bayan ka amince da shi. Babu wani abu da aka sanya hannu ko aika.

about.title: Game da ChainBeat
about.demo: ChainBeat yana gudana a yanayin Demo. Kowane toshe, farashi, mai tabbatarwa da shawarwari ana kirkirar su ta hanyar ƙayyadewa a cikin burauzarka. Waɗannan ba statistics na yanzu ba ne.
about.privacy: Babu buƙatar maɓallin API, maɓallin sirri ko kalmar asali. Ana adana asusun demo na zaɓi, fifiko da walat ɗin demo kawai a cikin burauzarku.
about.languages: Harsunan dubawa: {{shipped}} daga cikin {{total}}. Fassara suna da taimakon inji kuma ba'a sake nazarin su ta hanyar masu magana da su ba; ana ba da shawarar yin nazarin ƙwararru kafin amfani da jama'a.
about.pageDescription: Menene ChainBeat, yadda yake sarrafa bayanai, da gajerun hanyoyin keyboard.
